in_sanskrit.name: Konda
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Bond, Connection
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Konda एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Sanskrit, Konda means bond, connection, or relation. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kri', meaning to do, and 'da', meaning friend. In Hindu mythology, Konda is also the name of a goddess, Kondamamba, who is the goddess of fertility and the protector of children.
